methodology:
Duxton Broadacre Farms operates ~26,000 hectares of owned land plus manages additional area on behalf of other Duxton funds. The owned portfolio is dominated by NSW Western Riverina dryland cropping (~50K acres) with smaller positions in NT and WA, plus 1,491 acres of dried-grape vineyards (Australia's 2nd-largest sultanas grower).

FY25 (Jun 2025) was challenging — the company posted negative EBITDA of A$9M as drought + weak grain prices weighed on cropping. Land FMV is structurally less volatile than earnings; 2024-25 LAWD + Elders dryland transactions consistently track $1,500-2,000 AUD/acre depending on rainfall and infrastructure.
